_firewall: gamma reads the promoter switch-threshold STRUCTURE only. It is BLIND to whether the furnace is present/functional/driven and to the endotherm-vs-ectotherm verdict. It is NOT a metabolic rate, a body temperature, or a thermogenic capacity. The endotherm/ectotherm criterion is the PRESENCE of a drivable thermogenic effector-command pair (cited biology), never a gamma value.

ADRB3.role: beta-3 adrenergic sympathetic command that recruits the furnace

CIDEA.role: brown/beige adipocyte lipid-droplet protein (BAT identity marker)

DIO2.role: type-2 deiodinase: local T4->T3 activation required for BAT adaptive thermogenesis

FGF21.role: fasting/torpor endocrine signal driving browning + fuel switching

PDK4.role: pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 4: fuel-switch to lipid + glucose sparing

PPARGC1A.role: PGC-1alpha: master coactivator of mitochondrial biogenesis + adaptive thermogenesis

SLC2A4.role: GLUT4 insulin-responsive glucose transporter (torpor glucose-sparing <-> insulin-resistance node)

_provenance: gamma = -mean(NN stacking dG37, SantaLucia 1998) over the promoter window TSS-2000..+500; READ-ONLY genomic promoters via NCBI eutils (esearch->esummary exact-symbol->efetch nuccore). IDENTICAL window/NN table as the human energy atlas, so every gamma lands on the SAME scale. Sequences are cached below so gamma reproduces offline bit-for-bit; NCBI is contacted only if the cache is absent.
_what: Cross-species furnace/torpor promoter panel (UCP1 furnace, ADRB3 sympathetic command, PDK4 + PPARGC1A/DIO2/CIDEA/FGF21/SLC2A4 fuel-switch / BAT program), across deep hibernators, daily heterotherms, non-hibernators and ectotherms.

Cavia porcellus.torpor_note: non-hibernating rodent (guinea pig) -- GC-matched rodent control

Microcebus murinus.torpor_note: PRIMATE heterotherm: daily + seasonal torpor (gray mouse lemur) [cited: Schmid 2000]

Sus scrofa.torpor_note: UCP1 pseudogene (no functional UCP1 furnace; cited)

Urocitellus parryii.torpor_note: extreme deep hibernator, Tb to ~-2.9C (Arctic ground squirrel) [cited: Barnes 1989]

Ursus americanus.torpor_note: denning hibernator; mild-Tb multiday torpor (American black bear) [cited: Toien 2011]
